instruction: Security-review the payment code in src/ (spec.md explains the context) before it ships. Do not modify src/. Write SECURITY.json in this directory: a JSON array with one object per exploitable defect, each {"file": "src/<name>.mjs", "line": <line number>, "severity": "CRITICAL|HIGH|MEDIUM|LOW", "issue": "<the attack and its impact>"}. Report only defects you can justify; write [] if there are none.
